records.title: Enhancing cryopreservation of human induced pluripotent stem cells: Bottom-up versus conventional freezing geometry.
records.outcome: Bottom-up freezing improved membrane integrity by up to 9% and metabolic state by up to 21% versus conventional geometry; benefit remained after scale-up to 30 mL bags.
records.dose_or_protocol: 30 mL scale-up stated; other dose details not stated in abstract.
records.evidence_excerpt: bottom-up freezing under optimized conditions significantly increases iPSC viability, up to 9% for cell membrane integrity and up to 21% for cell metabolic state
records.version_status: journal version; paired preprint below should not be double-counted

records.title: Enhancing cryopreservation of human iPSCs: Bottom-up vs Conventional freezing geometry
records.outcome: Abstract reports up to 9% membrane-integrity and 21% metabolic-state improvement with bottom-up geometry, maintained at 30 mL scale.
records.dose_or_protocol: 30 mL scale-up stated; other details not stated.
records.evidence_excerpt: The improvement achieved for bottom-up versus conventional freezing was maintained after scale-up from cryogenic vials to 30 mL bags
records.version_status: preprint; same authors and near-identical abstract to journal DOI 10.1002/btpr.70019

records.title: DMSO-free cryopreservation of hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes: low temperature characterization and protocol development.
records.study_type: primary optimization and mechanistic hiPSC-CM cryopreservation
records.outcome: Optimized naturally occurring osmolyte cocktail enabled >90% post-thaw recovery versus 69.4 ± 6.4% DMSO; 5 °C/min cooling and −8 °C nucleation were optimal; cardiac function preserved.
records.dose_or_protocol: 5 °C/min; nucleation −8 °C; cocktail component concentrations not stated in abstract.
records.evidence_excerpt: The best-performing DMSO-free solutions enabled post-thaw recoveries over 90%, which was significantly greater than DMSO (69.4 ± 6.4%).
records.version_status: journal version; paired preprint below should not be double-counted

records.title: DMSO-free cryopreservation of hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes: Low temperature characterization and protocol development
records.outcome: Same reported >90% DMSO-free recovery, 69.4 ± 6.4% DMSO comparator, and 5 °C/min/−8 °C optimum.
records.dose_or_protocol: As stated in paired journal abstract.
records.evidence_excerpt: A rapid cooling rate of 5 °C/min and a low nucleation temperature of -8 °C was found to be optimal
records.version_status: preprint; same authors and near-identical abstract to journal DOI 10.1186/s13287-025-04384-5

records.title: Improved cryopreservation of cardiomyocyte aggregates differentiated from GMP iPSC in a 3D culture format.
records.outcome: 10% human serum albumin medium was best tested; at day 5 post-thaw, >90% cardiac marker expression, spontaneous contraction, and >80% vital-cell recovery were reported.
records.evidence_excerpt: Analysis at 5-days post thawing revealed maintenance of high cardiac marker expression (>90%), spontaneous contraction activity, and overall recovery of >80% vital cell counts

records.title: Cryopreservation alters contractile function of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes.
records.outcome: CS10 recovery 39% and KSR recovery 46%; cryopreservation altered morphology and contractile parameters despite slight sarcomeric expression changes.
records.dose_or_protocol: CryoStor CS10 and KnockOut Serum Replacement; concentrations not stated.
records.evidence_excerpt: both cryopreservation media (CryoStor® CS10 and KnockOut Serum Replacement) had a comparable recovery rate (CS10: 39%, KSR: 46%)

records.title: Amino acid-functionalised trehalose for multifunctional cryopreservation.
records.study_type: primary compound synthesis, physical assay, cytocompatibility, and mammalian-cell cryopreservation
records.outcome: Trehalose diesters of glycine, alanine, and proline showed IRI, controlled nucleation, radical scavenging, lower cytotoxicity than DMSO/trehalose in HaCaT cells, and measurable cryoprotection but lower recovery than 10 wt% DMSO.
records.dose_or_protocol: 10 wt% DMSO comparator; Tg up to −25 °C for proline diester; other concentrations not stated.
records.evidence_excerpt: Cryopreservation trials revealed diesters 1a-c conferred measurable cryoprotection, despite lower overall recovery relative to 10 wt% DMSO.

screening_note: Journal/preprint pairs are retained as separate metadata records but share duplicate_group and count once. Abstract-only outcomes are provisional; no unreported doses or protocol details were inferred.
